answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Interest & Insurance Question ID: 9895 Country: India Title: Aslwkm Mohataram Ulema Ekram. Kya bank sey loan lena durust hai kya. ghar key papers ya sona rak kar? Question: Aslwkm Mohataram Ulema Ekram. Kya bank sey loan lena durust hai kya. ghar key papers ya sona rak kar? Answer ID: 9895 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 19/21=B/1429) By taking loan, one in any case has to give interest while repaying the loan; therefore one should avoid it as much as possible. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
